attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 18 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys) on Alpine Linux 3.23. All replication traffic is carried over TLS 1.3 and restricted to peers presenting a certificate issued by a cluster-dedicated CA (mutual TLS, clientcert=verify-full). All three nodes were then individually restarted (native reboot, one at a time, standbys first then primary), with boot identity, service health, and replication/data verified both before and after each restart.
